title: 09. Production & Safety: Observability & Tracing
summary: Observability = the ability to understand what your agent is doing at every step. Without it, debugging a production failure is like finding a needle in a haystack — blindfolded.

sections.title: What Is It?
sections.body: > Observability = the ability to understand what your agent is doing **at every step**. Without it, debugging a production failure is like finding a needle in a haystack — blindfolded.

sections.title: Observability Explained
sections.body:
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│              OBSERVABILITY — THE 3 PILLARS                      │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

  PILLAR 1: TRACES (What happened, in what order?)
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  A trace = complete record of ONE request through the system.

  Request: "What is the weather in Tokyo?"
  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │  TRACE ID: abc-123                                      │
  │  Total time: 2.3 seconds                                │
  │                                                         │
  │  ├── [llm_call]        0ms → 800ms    (800ms)  ✅       │
  │  │     model: gpt-4o                                    │
  │  │     tokens: 450 in, 50 out                           │
  │  │                                                       │
  │  ├── [tool: get_weather]  800ms → 1200ms  (400ms) ✅    │
  │  │     city: Tokyo                                      │
  │  │     result: 22°C, sunny                              │
  │  │                                                       │
  │  └── [llm_call]        1200ms → 2300ms  (1100ms) ✅     │
  │        model: gpt-4o                                    │
  │        tokens: 520 in, 80 out                           │
  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

  PILLAR 2: METRICS (How is the system performing?)
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Aggregated numbers over time:

  ┌──────────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────┐
  │  Metric              │  Value (last 1 hour)              │
  ├──────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────┤
  │  Total requests      │  4,523                            │
  │  Success rate        │  99.2%                            │
  │  Avg latency         │  1.8s                             │
  │  P95 latency         │  4.2s (95% complete under 4.2s)   │
  │  P99 latency         │  8.1s (99% complete under 8.1s)   │
  │  Token usage         │  2.3M tokens                      │
  │  Total cost          │  $11.50                           │
  │  Cache hit rate      │  34%                              │
  │  Tool call count     │  8,910                            │
  └──────────────────────┴───────────────────────────────────┘

  PILLAR 3: LOGS (What went wrong and why?)
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Structured, searchable records of events:

  {"timestamp":"2025-01-15T14:23:01Z", "level":"ERROR",
   "trace_id":"abc-123", "event":"tool_failed",
   "tool":"get_weather", "error":"ConnectionTimeout",
   "city":"Tokyo", "attempt":2, "duration_ms":5000}

  {"timestamp":"2025-01-15T14:23:06Z", "level":"INFO",
   "trace_id":"abc-123", "event":"tool_retry_success",
   "tool":"get_weather", "attempt":3, "duration_ms":380}

  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  WITHOUT OBSERVABILITY:               WITH OBSERVABILITY:
  ─────────────────────────────        ─────────────────────────
  "Something is slow"                  "LLM call takes 4.2s for
  (which part? no idea)                queries over 2000 tokens"

  "Users report errors"                "Tool get_weather fails 2%
  (what errors? unknown)               of time with timeout at
                                       5000ms — reduce to 3000ms"

  "Cost went up this week"             "New prompt template is
  (why? mystery)                       500 tokens longer → $200
                                       extra per day"
```
